<a id="rules"></a>
## Rules every class shares

- **Global cooldown:** 1s after most skills (tooltips say when a skill does not trigger it).
- **Facing:** casts and swings need the target inside the 180° half-circle in front of you.
- **Diminishing returns:** the same kind of crowd control on one target lasts 100% → 50% → 25% → immune; the count resets after 18s without it. Interrupts have their own school lockout instead.
- **Stealth:** a stealthed rogue is seen within 2 yards; damage or attacking breaks it.
- **Fear:** a feared unit stumbles around at 35% run speed.
- **Out of combat:** 5s without dealing or taking damage.
- **No random damage:** every hit and heal does exactly the number on its tooltip.

<a id="warrior"></a>
## Warrior

Heavy melee fighter. Builds rage by fighting. Charges in, hamstrings, interrupts.

- **Health:** 3400
- **Rage:** 100 max, start with 0; built by dealing damage (15% of it with a free skill or auto-attack) and taking damage (7.5%), and drains 5 a second out of combat
- **Specs:** [Warbringer](#warrior-arms) (Dual wield) · [Rampager](#warrior-fury) (Two-handed sword) · [Barbarian](#warrior-protection) (Control / reach)

**Talents every Warrior spec shares** (one pick per tier, kept when you change spec):

| Tier | Talent | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| I | 🦘 **Leaping Strides** | Heroic Leap recharges 25% sooner and Charge 15% sooner. |
|  | 🦵 **Crippling Technique** | Hamstring's slow lasts 40% longer and Pummel recharges 20% sooner. |
|  | 🐗 **Battle Rush** | Charge reaches 5 yards further and recharges 20% sooner. |
| II | 🛡️ **Iron Constitution** | +8% maximum health. |
|  | 👟 **Fleet of Foot** | +6% movement speed. |
|  | 💪 **Savage Might** | +4% damage done. |

<a id="skill-slice-and-dice"></a>
#### Slice and Dice

*Physical* · 30 rage · 6 yd range, 90° cone in front of you · 4s channel · 30s cooldown · 1.1s stun

- Strikes every enemy in range 4 times, once every 1s (the first at once), for 100 physical damage each (400 total). Moving or being interrupted stops it.

On the bar: [Warbringer](#warrior-arms) (key 4).

<a id="skill-charge"></a>
#### Charge

*Physical* · 25 yd range · min 8 yd · Instant · 15s cooldown

- Stuns the target for up to 2.5s as you sprint at it, closing the distance in about a second, then hits it for 50 and ends the stun when you land. You cannot steer while charging; taking damage, a stun or a root stops you (and frees the target).
- Generates 10 rage.
- *Its damage builds rage: 15% of the damage dealt (8 per hit).*
- *Does not trigger the global cooldown.*

On the bar: [Warbringer](#warrior-arms) (key 5), [Rampager](#warrior-fury) (key 5), [Barbarian](#warrior-protection) (key 5).

<a id="rogue"></a>
## Rogue

Stealth melee assassin. Stuns from stealth, kicks casters, hard to pin down.

- **Health:** 2800
- **Energy:** 100 max, start with 100, +15 a second; skills that award combo points fill up to 5 for finishers to spend
- **Specs:** [Cutthroat](#rogue-assassination) (Burst melee) · [Duelist](#rogue-combat) (Sustained melee) · [Shade](#rogue-subtlety) (Control / mobility)

**Talents every Rogue spec shares** (one pick per tier, kept when you change spec):

| Tier | Talent | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| I | 💨 **Smoke Veil** | Vanish also drops a 6-yard smoke cloud for 6 seconds: only enemies and allies inside it can target each other. |
|  | 🌫️ **Twin Vanish** | Vanish holds two charges, and each charge recharges on its own timer. |
|  | 💚 **Shadow Mend** | Vanishing heals you for 75% of your missing health. |
| II | ⚡ **Quiet Reserves** | Energy regenerates 20% faster. |
|  | 👟 **Fleet Footed** | You move 10% faster. |
|  | 🎯 **Deep Pockets** | Three extra combo point slots (8 in all), and combo point payoffs scale 15% harder per point. |

<a id="rogue-assassination"></a>

Stealth openers into heavy hits. Mutilate and Garrote leave bleeds; Exsanguinate cashes in on them.

- **Auto-attack:** 50 damage every 1.8s, 3 yd reach

| 4 | [Kick](#skill-kick) | 3 yd range · Instant · 15s cooldown |
| 5 | [Vanish](#skill-vanish) | Instant · 120s cooldown |
| 6 | [Sprint](#skill-sprint) | Instant · 60s cooldown · 8s speed boost |
